answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks by making every new identity buy a costly%2c verifiable stake%3a to join%2c an agent must lock collateral and pass a unique hardware attestation tied to a real device. A copycat can mint a thousand fake names%2c but each one drains real resources%2c so the swarm of impostors collapses under its own cost. Honest peers stand out like a lone cedar on a windy knoll above the tundra %a1%aa visible%2c rooted%2c and expensive to counterfeit.
